subject_uz: GB-1201 MR kompressorining quruq gaz zichlagichlarini (2 ta) ta'mirlash va tiklash xizmati (1 591 062 500 so'm)

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik taklif texnik topshiriqning barcha talablariga muvofiq bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The technical offer must comply with all requirements of the technical assignment.
requirements.quote: Texnik taklif texnik topshiriqning barcha talablariga muvofiq bo'lishi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'mirlash doirasi: qismlarga ajratish, tozalash va tekshirish, juftlashuvchi halqalarni silliqlash, o'lchash va aylanish sinovi, yangi halqa va prokladkalar, qayta yig'ish.
requirements.summary_en: Repair scope: disassembly, cleaning and inspection, polishing, measuring and spin test of mating rings, new seal rings and gaskets, reassembly.
requirements.quote: Juftlashuvchi halqa, 4-pozitsiya, silliqlash, o'lchash va aylanish sinovi

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi API standartiga muvofiq statik va dinamik tekshiruv o'tkazib, sinov natijalarini berishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must perform static and dynamic tests per the API standard and supply the results.
requirements.quote: It must state that it will conduct static and dynamic inspections in accordance with the API

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi oxirgi 2 yilda shu turdagi quruq gaz zichlagichlarini ta'mirlaganligi to'g'risida ma'lumot (buyurtmachi va davlat ko'rsatilgan holda) taqdim etishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must show repair of this type of dry gas seal in the last 2 years (customer and country named).
requirements.quote: oxirgi 2 yil davomida shu turdagi quruq

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi kompressor ishlab chiqaruvchisi MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES tavsiya etgan yoki Shurtan GKM uskunalarida ilgari shunday ta'mirlashni bajargan kompaniya bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must be recommended by compressor maker Mitsubishi Heavy Industries or have previously repaired such seals on Shurtan GCC equipment.
requirements.quote: должна быть рекомендована компанией MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES (Япония) или ООО

requirements.summary_uz: Yetkazib beruvchi ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki uning rasmiy dileri bo'lishi va dilerlik sertifikati nusxasini taqdim etishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The supplier must be the manufacturer or its official dealer and attach a dealer certificate copy.

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi zichlagichlarni Shurtan GKM obyektidan o'z hisobidan chet elga olib chiqib, ta'mirdan keyin qaytarib olib kiradi; barcha tashish, sug'urta va bojxona xarajatlari narxga kiritiladi.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor exports the seals for repair abroad and re-imports them at its own cost; transport, insurance and customs are included in the price.
requirements.quote: Подрядчик по ремонту обязан вывезти уплотнения сухого газа (DGS) с объекта Заказчика

requirements.summary_uz: Tashishdan oldin zichlagichlar sug'urtalanishi va sug'urta polisi nusxasi buyurtmachiga berilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Seals must be insured before transport and a copy of the policy given to the customer.
requirements.quote: Перед транспортировкой СГУ подлежат страхованию в установленном порядке.

requirements.summary_uz: Ta'mirdan keyin zichlagichlar Shurtan posyolkasida buyurtmachi manziliga DDP shartlarida yetkaziladi.
requirements.summary_en: After repair the seals are delivered DDP to the customer in Shurtan.
requirements.quote: Базис поставки для резидентов/ Delivery basis for residents: DDP Узбекистан, индекс 180300, Кашкадарьинская область, Гузарский район, поселок Шуртан

requirements.summary_uz: Kafolat muddati yetkazib berilgan kundan kamida 12 oy.
requirements.summary_en: Warranty of at least 12 months from delivery.
requirements.quote: Поставщик устанавливает на товар гарантийный срок не менее 12 месяцев с момента передачи товара.

requirements.summary_uz: Moliyaviy hisobotlar (auditor yoki soliq organi tasdiqlagan buxgalteriya balansi) taqdim etilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Financial statements (accounting balance sheet confirmed by an auditor or the tax authority) are required.
requirements.quote: Молиявий ҳисоботлар* (ташқи аудитор ташкилотлар томонидан тасдиқланган ёки солиқ органлари томонидан қабул қилинганлиги тасдиқланган ҳолда): 1. Бухгалтерия баланси

requirements.summary_uz: 1, 2, 3-shakllar va talab qilingan hujjatlar to'liq topshirilmasa, ishtirokchi diskvalifikatsiya qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Bidders who do not submit Forms 1, 2, 3 and the required documents in full are disqualified.
requirements.quote: Участники, не предоставившие документы, указанные в разделах «Квалификационные требования» и «Технические требования», включая формы 1, 2, 3 и приложении к ним, в полном объеме

flags.quote: должна быть рекомендована компанией MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES (Япония) или ООО
flags.explanation_uz: Ta'mirlovchi kompaniya kompressor ishlab chiqaruvchisi MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES tavsiyasiga ega bo'lishi yoki Shurtan GKM uskunalarida ilgari xuddi shunday ishni bajargan bo'lishi kerak. Bu 1 591 062 500 so'mlik lotda dunyoning boshqa malakali ta'mirlash ustaxonalarini ishtirokdan chetlatishi mumkin; buyurtmachi kompressor kafolati sababli buni asoslashi mumkin, shuning uchun tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.
flags.explanation_en: The repairer must be recommended by compressor maker Mitsubishi Heavy Industries or have previously done the same work on Shurtan GCC equipment. On a lot of 1,591,062,500 UZS this may exclude other qualified repair shops; the customer may justify it by the compressor warranty, so a person should check it.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ijrochi API standartiga muvofiq quruq gaz zichlagichlarini ta'mirlash bo'yicha oxirgi 2 yilda kamida bitta shunday ishni bajarganini hujjatlar bilan tasdiqlashi kerak.
flags.rewrite_en: The contractor must document at least one comparable dry gas seal repair in the last 2 years carried out to the API standard.

flags.explanation_uz: Texnik topshiriq yetkazib beruvchi ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki uning rasmiy dileri bo'lishi va dilerlik sertifikati nusxasini berishini talab qiladi; bundan tashqari ishlab chiqaruvchi tasdiqlagan maxsus blankadagi rasmiy hujjat so'raladi. Bu ta'mirlash xizmati uchun mustaqil ta'mirlash korxonalarini chetlashtirishi mumkin va u yuqoridagi tavsiya talabi bilan bir-birini to'ldiradi.
flags.explanation_en: The assignment requires the supplier to be the manufacturer or its official dealer and to provide a dealer certificate copy, and also asks for an official document on a special form approved by the manufacturer. For a repair service this may shut out independent repair companies, on top of the recommendation requirement above.
flags.rewrite_uz: Dilerlik sertifikati o'rniga ishtirokchining shu turdagi ta'mirlash ishlariga malakasini tasdiqlovchi har qanday hujjatni (sinov hisoboti, avvalgi shartnoma, sifat tizimi sertifikati) qabul qiling.
flags.rewrite_en: Instead of a dealer certificate, accept any document showing the bidder's competence for this type of repair (test report, prior contract, quality-system certificate).

documents_needed_uz: Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi va ta'sis hujjatlari
Moliyaviy hisobotlar (buxgalteriya balansi) auditor yoki soliq organi tasdig'i bilan
Ishlab chiqaruvchi tasdiqlagan maxsus blankada kafolat majburiyatlari to'g'risidagi rasmiy hujjat
Oxirgi 2 yilda shunday zichlagichlarni ta'mirlash tajribasi to'g'risida ma'lumot (buyurtmachi va davlat)
Ta'mirlash o'tkaziladigan joy va mamlakat ko'rsatilgan ma'lumot
Statik va dinamik sinov hamda tekshiruv hisobotlari uchun majburiyat
Sifat sertifikati (asl nusxa yoki muhrli nusxa)
